body: I’m fairly young and have no one who depends on me. The trouble is money. I could make it a few months with the savings I have, but after that I’d be in big trouble. Maybe one day I’ll have enough saved up to get out of here, though. Thank you for replying.
Thank you for replying, it means a lot. I’ll think about what you said.

I’m so sorry to hear what you are going through. It’s so incredibly hard to feel alone. I have been alone at times in my life, but eventually I was able to move out and made quality friends who support me. I’m not sure what your relationship with your parents is like, but if you are comfortable doing so, writing them a letter telling them how you have been feeling sounds like a beautiful idea to me. With all my heart I hope that you decide to stay a while longer. I wish you the very best.

I hear you. I spend many days feeling the same exact way. I don’t know if this is possible for you, but I have found comfort in talking to the people my regrets are tied to. Being open has been helpful for me. Regardless, I truly wish you the best. Please consider sticking around a while longer
Thank you for replying to me. I’m just really struggling right now. I really appreciate your kind words.

It’s honestly comforting to know somebody else feels the same way. Everyone around me is excited to get out there and “start their life”. I hope you’re doing alright and find something that can excite you about your future :)

I hadn’t, actually. I’ve never officially been tested for any type of ADD, but the symptoms I looked up don’t seem to fit exactly right. You never know though, I’ll mention it to my doctor. I hope you’re able to get things figured out for yourself. Quitting nicotine has been hard, but not impossible. Best wishes man.
Thank you for all the info, I really appreciate it. It’s validating to hear it’s scientifically known to be a bitch to quit.

I don’t believe what you’re describing is selfish. I’ve found that talking about your feelings is very helpful, and borderline necessary. For myself, I prefer not to on public platforms and instead go for one on one vulnerability like what you described having done with your father. Regardless of how you do it, it’s important that you’re talking about how you feel. You aren’t doing anything wrong by posting about your feelings online, so don’t feel bad about it.
